dct_description_sm: Since 2013, this case has been played 11091 times.

Harriet, an inpatient in hospital, has altered levels of consciousness. Students have to solve all 3 parts of this case to figure out why. Created for the TIDE project on early brain and biological development, in conjunction with CaMH, AFMC and funded by the Norlien Foundation. Case can now be played at https://player.olab4.net/1974/0
